       When the ribbon cools past the strain point, differential thermal contraction produces locked-in

    END_FOR;

    (* Clear Smith Predictor FIFO Ring Buffers *)
    FOR i := 0 TO 63 DO
        rFifoDelay_LE[i] := -4.0;
        rFifoDelay_RE[i] := -4.0;
    END_FOR;

    bInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 2: SIL-3 SAFETY INSTRUMENTED INTERLOCKS & MASTER PERMISSIVES
Monitors hardwired E-Stop, acoustic fracture detection, and initiates failsafe tripping
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Acoustic emission micro-crack pulse monitoring *)
tonAcousticTripTimer(IN := bAcousticCrackDetected, PT := T#500MS);

IF NOT bEmergencyStopSIS THEN
    (* Immediate Fail-Safe Trip: De-energize all heating ribbon SCR outputs *)
    bEmergencyCoolingTrip   := TRUE;
    bLehrReady              := FALSE;
    bControlActive          := FALSE;
    rSCRPower_FarLeft_kW    := 0.0;
    rSCRPower_Left_kW       := 0.0;
    rSCRPower_Center_kW     := 0.0;
    rSCRPower_Right_kW      := 0.0;
    rSCRPower_FarRight_kW   := 0.0;
    rTotalHeatingLoad_kW    := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord.15           := TRUE; (* Critical Safety Interlock Tripped *)
    wStatusWord             := 16#8000; (* Bit 15: Trip Latched *)
    iState                  := 99;   (* Jump immediately to Failsafe State *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF bAcousticCrackDetected OR tonAcousticTripTimer.Q THEN
    wAlarmWord.7 := TRUE; (* Bit 7: Glass Micro-Fracture Acoustic Anomaly *)
    (* If stress is highly tensile, escalate directly to Emergency Overdrive State 90 *)
    IF (rMeasuredStress_LE_MPa > 0.0) OR (rMeasuredStress_RE_MPa > 0.0) THEN
        iState := 90;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 3: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) TEMPERATURE VOTING & HEALTH LOGIC
Executes median-filtering, channel deviation assessment, fault qualification timers,
and graceful degradation to 1oo2 or 1oo1 fallback modes for Left Edge, Center, and Right Edge.
====================================================================================================
*)
(* --- LEFT EDGE ZONE A 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
(* Compute Median of 3 Channels *)
IF (rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC >= rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC AND rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC <= rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC) OR
   (rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC <= rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC AND rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC >= rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC) THEN
    rVotedTemp_LE_degC := rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC;
ELSIF (rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC >= rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC AND rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC <= rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC) OR
      (rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC <= rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC AND rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC >= rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC) THEN
    rVotedTemp_LE_degC := rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC;
ELSE
    rVotedTemp_LE_degC := rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC;
END_IF;

(* Channel Deviation from Median *)
rLE_Dev1 := ABS(rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC - rVotedTemp_LE_degC);
rLE_Dev2 := ABS(rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC - rVotedTemp_LE_degC);
rLE_Dev3 := ABS(rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC - rVotedTemp_LE_degC);

(* Channel Qualification Timers: Deviation > 6.0 deg C persistent for 3.0 s *)
tonLE_FaultTmr1(IN := (rLE_Dev1 > 6.0) OR (rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);
tonLE_FaultTmr2(IN := (rLE_Dev2 > 6.0) OR (rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);
tonLE_FaultTmr3(IN := (rLE_Dev3 > 6.0) OR (rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);

bLE_Ch1_Fail := tonLE_FaultTmr1.Q;
bLE_Ch2_Fail := tonLE_FaultTmr2.Q;
bLE_Ch3_Fail := tonLE_FaultTmr3.Q;

iLE_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bLE_Ch1_Fail THEN iLE_HealthyCount := iLE_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bLE_Ch2_Fail THEN iLE_HealthyCount := iLE_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bLE_Ch3_Fail THEN iLE_HealthyCount := iLE_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

(* Degraded Mode Logic for Left Edge *)
IF iLE_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    wAlarmWord.0 := TRUE; (* Bit 0: Left Edge Single Channel Fault (1oo2 Degraded) *)
    IF bLE_Ch1_Fail THEN
        rVotedTemp_LE_degC := (rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC + rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bLE_Ch2_Fail THEN
        rVotedTemp_LE_degC := (rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC + rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedTemp_LE_degC := (rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC + rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iLE_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    wAlarmWord.0 := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE; (* Bit 14: Sensor Redundancy Exhausted (1oo1 Fallback) *)
    IF NOT bLE_Ch1_Fail THEN rVotedTemp_LE_degC := rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC;
    ELSIF NOT bLE_Ch2_Fail THEN rVotedTemp_LE_degC := rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC;
    ELSE rVotedTemp_LE_degC := rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iLE_HealthyCount = 0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.0 := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
    (* Complete loss of Left Edge sensors: Hold last model estimate *)
    rVotedTemp_LE_degC := x_state[2];
END_IF;

(* --- CENTER CORE ZONE A 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
IF (rTempCenter_TMR1_degC >= rTempCenter_TMR2_degC AND rTempCenter_TMR1_degC <= rTempCenter_TMR3_degC) OR
   (rTempCenter_TMR1_degC <= rTempCenter_TMR2_degC AND rTempCenter_TMR1_degC >= rTempCenter_TMR3_degC) THEN
    rVotedTemp_C_degC := rTempCenter_TMR1_degC;
ELSIF (rTempCenter_TMR2_degC >= rTempCenter_TMR1_degC AND rTempCenter_TMR2_degC <= rTempCenter_TMR3_degC) OR
      (rTempCenter_TMR2_degC <= rTempCenter_TMR1_degC AND rTempCenter_TMR2_degC >= rTempCenter_TMR3_degC) THEN
    rVotedTemp_C_degC := rTempCenter_TMR2_degC;
ELSE
    rVotedTemp_C_degC := rTempCenter_TMR3_degC;
END_IF;

rC_Dev1 := ABS(rTempCenter_TMR1_degC - rVotedTemp_C_degC);
rC_Dev2 := ABS(rTempCenter_TMR2_degC - rVotedTemp_C_degC);
rC_Dev3 := ABS(rTempCenter_TMR3_degC - rVotedTemp_C_degC);

tonC_FaultTmr1(IN := (rC_Dev1 > 6.0) OR (rTempCenter_TMR1_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempCenter_TMR1_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);
tonC_FaultTmr2(IN := (rC_Dev2 > 6.0) OR (rTempCenter_TMR2_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempCenter_TMR2_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);
tonC_FaultTmr3(IN := (rC_Dev3 > 6.0) OR (rTempCenter_TMR3_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempCenter_TMR3_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);

bC_Ch1_Fail := tonC_FaultTmr1.Q;
bC_Ch2_Fail := tonC_FaultTmr2.Q;
bC_Ch3_Fail := tonC_FaultTmr3.Q;

iC_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bC_Ch1_Fail THEN iC_HealthyCount := iC_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bC_Ch2_Fail THEN iC_HealthyCount := iC_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bC_Ch3_Fail THEN iC_HealthyCount := iC_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

IF iC_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    wAlarmWord.1 := TRUE; (* Bit 1: Center Core Single Channel Fault *)
    IF bC_Ch1_Fail THEN
        rVotedTemp_C_degC := (rTempCenter_TMR2_degC + rTempCenter_TMR3_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bC_Ch2_Fail THEN
        rVotedTemp_C_degC := (rTempCenter_TMR1_degC + rTempCenter_TMR3_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedTemp_C_degC := (rTempCenter_TMR1_degC + rTempCenter_TMR2_degC) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iC_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    wAlarmWord.1 := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
    IF NOT bC_Ch1_Fail THEN rVotedTemp_C_degC := rTempCenter_TMR1_degC;
    ELSIF NOT bC_Ch2_Fail THEN rVotedTemp_C_degC := rTempCenter_TMR2_degC;
    ELSE rVotedTemp_C_degC := rTempCenter_TMR3_degC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iC_HealthyCount = 0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.1 := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
    rVotedTemp_C_degC := x_state[3];
END_IF;

(* --- RIGHT EDGE ZONE A 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
IF (rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC >= rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC AND rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC <= rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC) OR
   (rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC <= rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC AND rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC >= rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC) THEN
    rVotedTemp_RE_degC := rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC;
ELSIF (rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC >= rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC AND rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC <= rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC) OR
      (rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC <= rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC AND rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC >= rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC) THEN
    rVotedTemp_RE_degC := rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC;
ELSE
    rVotedTemp_RE_degC := rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC;
END_IF;

rRE_Dev1 := ABS(rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC - rVotedTemp_RE_degC);
rRE_Dev2 := ABS(rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC - rVotedTemp_RE_degC);
rRE_Dev3 := ABS(rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC - rVotedTemp_RE_degC);

tonRE_FaultTmr1(IN := (rRE_Dev1 > 6.0) OR (rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);
tonRE_FaultTmr2(IN := (rRE_Dev2 > 6.0) OR (rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);
tonRE_FaultTmr3(IN := (rRE_Dev3 > 6.0) OR (rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);

bRE_Ch1_Fail := tonRE_FaultTmr1.Q;
bRE_Ch2_Fail := tonRE_FaultTmr2.Q;
bRE_Ch3_Fail := tonRE_FaultTmr3.Q;

iRE_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bRE_Ch1_Fail THEN iRE_HealthyCount := iRE_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bRE_Ch2_Fail THEN iRE_HealthyCount := iRE_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bRE_Ch3_Fail THEN iRE_HealthyCount := iRE_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

IF iRE_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    wAlarmWord.2 := TRUE; (* Bit 2: Right Edge Single Channel Fault *)
    IF bRE_Ch1_Fail THEN
        rVotedTemp_RE_degC := (rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC + rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bRE_Ch2_Fail THEN
        rVotedTemp_RE_degC := (rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC + rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedTemp_RE_degC := (rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC + rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iRE_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    wAlarmWord.2 := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
    IF NOT bRE_Ch1_Fail THEN rVotedTemp_RE_degC := rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC;
    ELSIF NOT bRE_Ch2_Fail THEN rVotedTemp_RE_degC := rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC;
    ELSE rVotedTemp_RE_degC := rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iRE_HealthyCount = 0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.2 := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
    rVotedTemp_RE_degC := x_state[4];
END_IF;

(* Compute Cross-Ribbon Transverse Thermal Gradient *)
rCrossRibbonDeltaT_degC := rVotedTemp_C_degC - ((rVotedTemp_LE_degC + rVotedTemp_RE_degC) * 0.5);
IF ABS(rCrossRibbonDeltaT_degC) > 22.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.4 := TRUE; (* Bit 4: Cross-Conveyor Thermal Gradient Limit Exceeded *)
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 4: PHOTOELASTIC STRESS EVALUATION & BREWSTER'S FORMULATION
Evaluates optical retardation [nm], converts to mechanical stress [MPa], and filters noise
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Sanitize ribbon thickness to prevent divide-by-zero *)
IF rGlassThickness_mm < 1.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.6 := TRUE; (* Bit 6: Glass Thickness Out-of-Range *)
    rGlassThickness_mm := 1.0;
ELSIF rGlassThickness_mm > 26.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.6 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* First-order Low-Pass Filter on Optical Retardation (tau_filter = 2.0 s, Ts = 1.0 s) *)
rFilteredRetardation_LE := (0.333 * rPolarimeterRetardation_LE_nm) + (0.667 * rFilteredRetardation_LE);
rFilteredRetardation_RE := (0.333 * rPolarimeterRetardation_RE_nm) + (0.667 * rFilteredRetardation_RE);

(*
   Stress-Optic Law:
   Retardation Delta [nm] = C_Brewster [nm / (mm * MPa)] * Thickness [mm] * Stress [MPa]
   Solving for Stress: sigma [MPa] = Delta / (C_Brewster * Thickness)
   Sign convention: Polarimeter output sign indicates compression (negative) or tension (positive)
*)
rRawStress_LE_MPa := rFilteredRetardation_LE / (rBrewsterCoeff * rGlassThickness_mm);
rRawStress_RE_MPa := rFilteredRetardation_RE / (rBrewsterCoeff * rGlassThickness_mm);

rMeasuredStress_LE_MPa := rRawStress_LE_MPa;
rMeasuredStress_RE_MPa := rRawStress_RE_MPa;

(* Critical Tensile Edge Stress Alarm: Tension > +0.8 MPa indicates imminent breakage risk *)
IF (rMeasuredStress_LE_MPa > 0.8) OR (rMeasuredStress_RE_MPa > 0.8) THEN
    wAlarmWord.3 := TRUE; (* Bit 3: High Residual Tensile Edge Stress (Break Hazard) *)
END_IF;

(* Optical Obscuration Alarm *)
IF (ABS(rPolarimeterRetardation_LE_nm) < 0.01) AND (bRibbonPresent) AND (iState >= 30) THEN
    wAlarmWord.9 := TRUE; (* Bit 9: Polarimeter Obscuration or Signal Drop *)
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 5: SMITH PREDICTOR TRANSPORT DEAD-TIME DYNAMICS (FIFO RING BUFFER)
Compensates for the spatial transport delay between Zone A electric heating ribbons
and downstream lehr exit polarimeters: tau_dead = L_lehr / (v_line / 60)
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Validate conveyor speed to prevent overflow *)
IF rConveyorSpeed_m_min < 1.5 THEN
    wAlarmWord.5 := TRUE; (* Bit 5: Lehr Conveyor Line Speed Abnormally Low *)
    rConveyorSpeed_m_min := 1.5;
END_IF;

(* Calculate physical dead time in seconds *)
rCalculatedDeadTime_s := (rLehrTransportDistance_m / (rConveyorSpeed_m_min / 60.0));

(* Convert to discrete integer sample steps (Ts = 1.0 s, clamped to 8..63 steps) *)
iFifoDelaySteps := REAL_TO_INT(rCalculatedDeadTime_s);
IF iFifoDelaySteps < 8 THEN
    iFifoDelaySteps := 8;
ELSIF iFifoDelaySteps > 63 THEN
    iFifoDelaySteps := 63;
    wAlarmWord.10 := TRUE; (* Bit 10: Smith Predictor Delay FIFO Saturated *)
END_IF;

(* Read delayed model output from ring buffer *)
k := (iFifoHead - iFifoDelaySteps + 64) MOD 64;
rModelStress_LE_Delayed := rFifoDelay_LE[k];
rModelStress_RE_Delayed := rFifoDelay_RE[k];

(* Smith Predictor Disturbance Error Innovation *)
rSmithCorrection_LE := rMeasuredStress_LE_MPa - rModelStress_LE_Delayed;
rSmithCorrection_RE := rMeasuredStress_RE_MPa - rModelStress_RE_Delayed;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 6: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE OBSERVER (KALMAN FILTER) & PROFILE TRACKER
Updates internal estimated 5-zone transverse temperature vector x_state based on voted TCs
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Pack Voted Sensor Feedback Vector y_meas = [T_LE, T_C, T_RE] *)
y_meas[1] := rVotedTemp_LE_degC;
y_meas[2] := rVotedTemp_C_degC;
y_meas[3] := rVotedTemp_RE_degC;

(* Compute Estimated Sensor Measurements y_est = C * x_state *)
FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    y_est[i] := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 5 DO
        y_est[i] := y_est[i] + (C_matrix[i,j] * x_state[j]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Innovation residual *)
    y_innov[i] := y_meas[i] - y_est[i];
END_FOR;

(* State Update with Observer Gain: x_corr = x_state + L_obs * y_innov *)
FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
        x_state[i] := x_state[i] + (L_obs[i,j] * y_innov[j]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Compute One-Step Ahead State Prediction: x_pred = A * x_state + B * u_prev *)
FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
    x_pred[i] := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 5 DO
        x_pred[i] := x_pred[i] + (A_matrix[i,j] * x_state[j]) + (B_matrix[i,j] * u_prev[j]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 7: MULTIVARIABLE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROLLER (MPC) & STRESS CASCADE
Generates cross-conveyor electric heating power demands for 5 zones, optimizing stress & profile
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Synthesize Transverse Target Temperature Profile Vector *)
(*
   Target Profile: Parabolic curvature with elevated edges to counter sidewall radiation.
   Offset edges by +8.0 to +12.0 deg C relative to center during steady annealing.
*)
x_target[1] := rAnnealingSetpoint_degC + 11.5; (* Far-Left Edge *)
x_target[2] := rAnnealingSetpoint_degC + 4.5;  (* Left Edge *)
x_target[3] := rAnnealingSetpoint_degC;        (* Center Core *)
x_target[4] := rAnnealingSetpoint_degC + 4.5;  (* Right Edge *)
x_target[5] := rAnnealingSetpoint_degC + 11.5; (* Far-Right Edge *)

(* Outer Cascade: Photoelastic Stress Trimming Integral Controllers *)
(*
   If edge stress is too tensile (e.g. -1.0 MPa instead of -4.0 MPa), error is positive ->
   add power to Far-Left / Left (and Far-Right / Right) heating ribbons to slow edge cooling!
*)
IF (iState = 40) AND bRibbonPresent THEN
    (* Left Edge Stress Controller *)
    rStressTrim_LE_kW := 3.2 * (rMeasuredStress_LE_MPa - rStressSetpoint_LE_MPa) + rStressInt_LE;
    rStressInt_LE := rStressInt_LE + (0.045 * (rMeasuredStress_LE_MPa - rStressSetpoint_LE_MPa));
    (* Anti-windup on outer stress integrator *)
    IF rStressInt_LE > 25.0 THEN rStressInt_LE := 25.0;
    ELSIF rStressInt_LE < -15.0 THEN rStressInt_LE := -15.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Right Edge Stress Controller *)
    rStressTrim_RE_kW := 3.2 * (rMeasuredStress_RE_MPa - rStressSetpoint_RE_MPa) + rStressInt_RE;
    rStressInt_RE := rStressInt_RE + (0.045 * (rMeasuredStress_RE_MPa - rStressSetpoint_RE_MPa));
    IF rStressInt_RE > 25.0 THEN rStressInt_RE := 25.0;
    ELSIF rStressInt_RE < -15.0 THEN rStressInt_RE := -15.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rStressTrim_LE_kW := 0.0;
    rStressTrim_RE_kW := 0.0;
    rStressInt_LE := 0.0;
    rStressInt_RE := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* MPC State Feedback Power Computation: u_mpc_raw = K_mpc * (x_target - x_pred) *)
FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
    u_mpc_raw[i] := 25.0; (* Base nominal feedforward power per zone [kW] *)
    FOR j := 1 TO 5 DO
        u_mpc_raw[i] := u_mpc_raw[i] + (K_mpc[i,j] * (x_target[j] - x_pred[j]));
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Superimpose Cascade Edge Stress Corrections *)
u_mpc_raw[1] := u_mpc_raw[1] + (1.20 * rStressTrim_LE_kW); (* Far-Left gets 120% stress trim *)
u_mpc_raw[2] := u_mpc_raw[2] + (0.80 * rStressTrim_LE_kW); (* Left gets 80% stress trim *)
u_mpc_raw[4] := u_mpc_raw[4] + (0.80 * rStressTrim_RE_kW); (* Right gets 80% stress trim *)
u_mpc_raw[5] := u_mpc_raw[5] + (1.20 * rStressTrim_RE_kW); (* Far-Right gets 120% stress trim *)

(* Update Smith Predictor Ring Buffer with undelayed predicted edge stress *)
(*
   Constitutive Model: delta_stress = -0.065 MPa / kW * (u_edge - nominal_u)
*)
iFifoHead := (iFifoHead + 1) MOD 64;
rFifoDelay_LE[iFifoHead] := rStressSetpoint_LE_MPa - (0.065 * (u_mpc_raw[1] - 25.0));
rFifoDelay_RE[iFifoHead] := rStressSetpoint_RE_MPa - (0.065 * (u_mpc_raw[5] - 25.0));

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 8: BUSBAR POWER MANAGEMENT, PRIORITY SCALING & CLAMPING
Guarantees total electric heating load does not exceed electrical substation capacity (rMaxSCRPowerCap_kW)
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Individual zone lower and upper physical bounds [0.0 kW to 95.0 kW] *)
rTargetPower_FLE := LIMIT(0.0, u_mpc_raw[1], 95.0);
rTargetPower_LE  := LIMIT(0.0, u_mpc_raw[2], 95.0);
rTargetPower_C   := LIMIT(0.0, u_mpc_raw[3], 95.0);
rTargetPower_RE  := LIMIT(0.0, u_mpc_raw[4], 95.0);
rTargetPower_FRE := LIMIT(0.0, u_mpc_raw[5], 95.0);

rSumRequestedPower := rTargetPower_FLE + rTargetPower_LE + rTargetPower_C + rTargetPower_RE + rTargetPower_FRE;

IF rSumRequestedPower > rMaxSCRPowerCap_kW THEN
    wAlarmWord.8 := TRUE; (* Bit 8: Total SCR Busbar Heating Capacity Saturated *)
    (* Scale back non-critical center zone power preferentially to preserve edge stress profile *)
    rPowerScaleFactor := (rMaxSCRPowerCap_kW - (rTargetPower_FLE + rTargetPower_FRE)) /
                         MAX(1.0, (rTargetPower_LE + rTargetPower_C + rTargetPower_RE));
    IF rPowerScaleFactor < 0.60 THEN
        (* Severe constraint: proportional scaling across all 5 zones *)
        rPowerScaleFactor := rMaxSCRPowerCap_kW / rSumRequestedPower;
        rTargetPower_FLE := rTargetPower_FLE * rPowerScaleFactor;
        rTargetPower_LE  := rTargetPower_LE * rPowerScaleFactor;
        rTargetPower_C   := rTargetPower_C * rPowerScaleFactor;
        rTargetPower_RE  := rTargetPower_RE * rPowerScaleFactor;
        rTargetPower_FRE := rTargetPower_FRE * rPowerScaleFactor;
    ELSE
        rTargetPower_LE := rTargetPower_LE * rPowerScaleFactor;
        rTargetPower_C  := rTargetPower_C * rPowerScaleFactor;
        rTargetPower_RE := rTargetPower_RE * rPowerScaleFactor;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 9: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) - CONTINUOUS LEHR ANNEALING
Manages deterministic progression from cold standby, preheat, glass handoff, closed-loop, and trips
====================================================================================================
*)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE 0: IDLE / LEHR STANDBY & PRE-PERMISSIVE VERIFICATION *)
        wStatusWord.0           := TRUE;
        bLehrReady              := FALSE;

        wStatusWord.1   := TRUE;

        rSCRPower_FarLeft_kW    := 30.0;

        rSCRPower_Right_kW      := 28.0;

        wStatusWord.3   := TRUE;

        rSCRPower_FarLeft_kW    := rTargetPower_FLE;
        rSCRPower_Left_kW       := rTargetPower_LE;

        rSCRPower_Right_kW      := rTargetPower_RE;

        tonStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#60S);

        END_IF;

        wStatusWord.4   := TRUE;

            wAlarmWord.13           := TRUE; (* Bit 13: Manual Power Override Active *)
            rSCRPower_FarLeft_kW    := (rManualDuty_FLE_pct * 0.01) * 95.0;
            rSCRPower_Left_kW       := (rManualDuty_LE_pct * 0.01) * 95.0;
            rSCRPower_Center_kW     := (rManualDuty_C_pct * 0.01) * 95.0;
            rSCRPower_Right_kW      := (rManualDuty_RE_pct * 0.01) * 95.0;
            rSCRPower_FarRight_kW   := (rManualDuty_FRE_pct * 0.01) * 95.0;
        ELSE
            (* Fully automated closed-loop SCR power output *)
            rSCRPower_FarLeft_kW    := rTargetPower_FLE;
            rSCRPower_Left_kW       := rTargetPower_LE;
            rSCRPower_Center_kW     := rTargetPower_C;
            rSCRPower_Right_kW      := rTargetPower_RE;
            rSCRPower_FarRight_kW   := rTargetPower_FRE;
        END_IF;

        (* Detect edge tension surge requiring state intervention *)
        IF (rMeasuredStress_LE_MPa > 1.2) OR (rMeasuredStress_RE_MPa > 1.2) THEN

        END_IF;

        IF NOT bRibbonPresent THEN
            iState := 0; (* Ribbon broken or campaign stopped *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: TRANSITION PROFILE (THICKNESS / SPEED RATE-OF-CHANGE) *)
        (* Executed during thickness transition (e.g. 4.0 mm -> 8.0 mm) or major lehr line speed steps *)
        wStatusWord.5   := TRUE;
        bControlActive  := TRUE;

        rSCRPower_FarLeft_kW    := rTargetPower_FLE * 1.10;
        rSCRPower_Left_kW       := rTargetPower_LE * 1.05;
        rSCRPower_Center_kW     := rTargetPower_C;
        rSCRPower_Right_kW      := rTargetPower_RE * 1.05;
        rSCRPower_FarRight_kW   := rTargetPower_FRE * 1.10;

        tonStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#45S);

        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: RECOVERY & HIGH-TENSION TRANSIENT SUPPRESSION *)
        (* Aggressive edge heating boost to suppress dangerous positive edge tension *)
        wStatusWord.6   := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord.12   := TRUE; (* Bit 12: High Edge Tension Suppression Routine Active *)

        (* Force edge ribbons into high power while depressing center *)
        rSCRPower_FarLeft_kW    := MIN(95.0, rTargetPower_FLE + 25.0);
        rSCRPower_Left_kW       := MIN(95.0, rTargetPower_LE + 15.0);
        rSCRPower_Center_kW     := MAX(5.0, rTargetPower_C - 10.0);
        rSCRPower_Right_kW      := MIN(95.0, rTargetPower_RE + 15.0);
        rSCRPower_FarRight_kW   := MIN(95.0, rTargetPower_FRE + 25.0);

        IF (rMeasuredStress_LE_MPa <= -2.0) AND (rMeasuredStress_RE_MPa <= -2.0) THEN
            tonStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#20S);
            IF tonStateTimer.Q THEN
                tonStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
                wAlarmWord.12 := FALSE;
                iState := 40; (* Safe edge compression restored: Return to Normal Control *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tonStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: EMERGENCY STRESS RELIEF OVERDRIVE (PREVENT STRIP EXPLOSION) *)
        (* Critical safety state triggered by acoustic crack sensor or extreme tensile spike *)
        wStatusWord.7   := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord.3    := TRUE;
        bEmergencyCoolingTrip := FALSE;

        (* Full maximum electrical drive to Far-Left and Far-Right ribbons to immediately expand edges *)
        rSCRPower_FarLeft_kW    := 95.0;
        rSCRPower_Left_kW       := 85.0;
        rSCRPower_Center_kW     := 0.0;
        rSCRPower_Right_kW      := 85.0;
        rSCRPower_FarRight_kW   := 95.0;

        IF tonOverdriveTimer.Q THEN
            tonOverdriveTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF NOT bAcousticCrackDetected THEN
                iState := 60; (* Demote to Recovery state *)
            ELSE
                iState := 99; (* Acoustic cracking persists: Emergency Failsafe Shutdown *)
            END_IF;

        (* SIL-3 Lockout: Power cut to all heating ribbons, alarm locked until manual reset *)
        wStatusWord.15          := TRUE;
        bLehrReady              := FALSE;
        bControlActive          := FALSE;

        rSCRPower_Left_kW       := 0.0;
        rSCRPower_Center_kW     := 0.0;
        rSCRPower_Right_kW      := 0.0;
        rSCRPower_FarRight_kW   := 0.0;

            wAlarmWord              := 16#0000;
            wStatusWord             := 16#0000;
            bEmergencyCoolingTrip   := FALSE;
            iState                  := 0; (* Reset back to Standby *)
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        (* Defensive Trapping: Unrecognized State Fallback *)
        iState := 99;
